steps.evidence: .devcontainer/postCreate.sh:45; SetupApplication.php runs storage:link, migrate --force, scout:setup, scribe:setup

notes: The README only links to docs.monicahq.com/developers/setup-local-development (external, not readable) and has no commands. The fullest in-repo setup is the devcontainer's postCreate.sh. It uses the default .env.example (SQLite, database cache/session, sync queue, log mailer), so no backing services are needed. Steps are listed in the script's execution order. The devcontainer serves the app through Apache on port 8080. `php artisan serve` on port 8000 (APP_URL in .env.example) is a convention for a plain host setup, not something the repo says. An alternative Laravel Sail path exists: .env.example.sail:4-7 says cp .env.example.sail .env, composer install via a laravelsail docker image (also sail-init.sh), then ./vendor/bin/sail up -d. That stack uses mariadb, redis, memcached, meilisearch and mailpit (docker-compose.yml) but never mentions key:generate or monica:setup. The Sail comment uses the php83 composer image, while sail-init.sh and the compose runtime use 8.4. CI calls reusable workflows from monicahq/workflows that cannot be read here; it shows only PHP 8.3/8.4, SQLite as the default connection and Node 22. .tool-versions pins php 8.3.16, nodejs 22.13.1 and yarn 4.6.0. The README warns this branch is the beta (5.x), while the stable version is on the 4.x branch.
